entries.title: Fixed Open Guide Coil Pogo Stick Display
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed pogo-stick display. A tall upper mast ends in one transverse bar and two thick end grips. Below it, two parallel guide side rails and two broad crossheads surround one genuine continuous seven-turn solid helix. A lower plunger extends to a thick flat-bottomed rubber-looking tip. Two complete side foot platforms each have a separate tread pad and a real short root brace into the lower crosshead. This is not an old bird-shaped spring rider with its body removed or a scooter without wheels: the whole narrow vertical grip-guide-plunger assembly and paired foot supports are new numeric geometry. One prop, zero scenes, three opaque untextured PBR materials, metres, native Z up and horizontally centred ground datum. Fixed empty simplified exterior only; visible coil is not a calibrated spring. No bouncing, compression, sliding, balance, rider fit, age suitability, loading, manufacture, use instructions or toy/sports safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed Plug Cord Operator Switchboard
entries.description: One newly authored complete static manual telephone-switchboard-style operator console. Two tall grounded step-shaped wooden side pedestals, full back, raised socket board and forward-projecting thick gently sloped plug desk form one integrated cabinet with a genuine front knee bay. A single dark upper face carries twelve complete blind socket cups with actual finite bore walls and closed backs, not painted dots or claimed holes through the solid backboard. Four complete lower cups and four blank controls form the forward plug bank. Two full upper plugs and two full lower plugs are joined by two independently continuous thick closed cords, each dropping in front of the desk into a broad hanging U and returning outside the lip to its parked lower grip. The other cup mouths remain empty. A blank header belongs to the same complete console. All numeric geometry is new: no old rotary phone, handmic, distribution box, wire component or desk imported or reassembled. Not a door-open box given more ports, nor a phone placed on furniture. One prop and zero scenes; individual ports, plugs, cords and controls do not count as extra assets. Four opaque constant untextured PBR materials, metres, Z up and actual horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. Fixed illustrative art only: no electrical circuits, continuity, signaling, switching, connection instructions, functional telephone service, socket compatibility, flexible cable dynamics, historical accuracy, operator ergonomics, manufacture, load or safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed Twin Barrel Bell Cover Air Pump Bench
entries.description: One newly authored whole static hand-cranked twin-barrel air-pump demonstration bench appearance. A single long wooden base on four finite feet carries two upright barrel exteriors with occupied annular glands, separate piston-style rods and transverse cross pins. A central pedestal supports a complete open-spoke handwheel, shaft, opposite fixed crank arms and two whole sloping connecting links, with an offset wood grip. Beside the pump, a round supported plate carries one thick opaque bell-shaped hollow cover; a fixed solid connecting tube exterior joins the pump housing to the plate support. All geometry is newly authored, not a twin-treadle water pump shortened or a portable tank compressor with its motor removed. One complete connected instrument display, zero scenes. Four opaque constant PBR materials, metres, native Z up, whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. The opaque bell hides its interior in normal view.
